decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the installation of internally illuminated fascia and projecting signs, as shown on drawing numbers 99990535/02 & 99990535/03, received 04 October 2006, is recommended for approval as the proposed development satisfactorily complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 All New Development, ENV-B.1.4 Advertisements, S.4.2 Shop Front Design, and S.4.3 Advertisements and Supplementary Planning Guidance. In this regard the proposed development would not adversely affect the visual quality of the building or the character of the street scene and it would maintain the amenity of surrounding properties and the function and vitality of Chiswick Town Centre.
Condition : 2 - The advertisement hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of one year from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 6 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 7 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.
description: Installation of internally illuminated fascia and projecting signs
